text:
[IRET.22.6] **TTL sweep.** Fact not retracted before its
deadline; fact retracted at or after deadline by the next
pump's TTL sweep ([IRET.19.3]); cascade: retraction of a TTL fact
propagates through the beta network and may trigger new
activations.

idris.name: iret_22_6__network_deadlines
idris.note: [IRET.22.6] ON THE NETWORK: for a certified positive program lowered from a loaded network, every input stream with ticks has a canonical replay from the loaded network at whose end the deadline table is well-formed on the network's working memory -- every live TTL fact has its deadline, no other live fact has one, and every live fact's deadline is after the clock.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__sweep_agree
idris.note: THE SWEEP AGREES: the network's retractions one at a time in [LDTL.6.1]'s order and FireLoop's batch end in one working memory, and the cascades after them agree.

idris.name: iret_22_6__at_or_after_deadline
idris.note: FACT RETRACTED AT OR AFTER ITS DEADLINE ON THE NEXT TICK. After the sweep at clock c every live fact with a deadline has it after c: whatever had expired is gone, in one batch, at the first boundary whose clock reaches it.

idris.name: iret_22_6__cascade
idris.note: THE RETRACTION CASCADES: the sweep's retraction is propagated through the network and followed by the truth-maintenance cascade [IRET.12.2]. Definitional: the sweep is defined as that composition, and the theorem restates it, so that the clause's third property is tied to the element that discharges it.

idris.name: iret_22_6__not_before_deadline
idris.note: FACT NOT RETRACTED BEFORE ITS DEADLINE. A live TTL fact whose deadline is after the clock is live after the sweep: the sweep skips it, and the cascade retracts only `logical` facts, which a TTL fact is not [LFAC.1.3.5].

idris.name: iret_22_6__not_expired
idris.note: A fact whose deadline row is after the clock is not among the sweep's retractions, its row being unique.

tla.name: lcrs_6_6_1__not_before_its_ttl
tla.note: The clause's first property on a call's answer: a response fact or CallError is retracted by the sweep only at an age of at least its TTL. Bounded: two calls, TTLs of 2 and 3 ticks. The cascade is not modelled.
